questions.question: All our (a)/ furnitures were (b)/ spoiled in the recent (c)/ rains and floods.(d)
questions.solution: use 'furniture was' instead of 'furnitures were'. kyunki 'furniture' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai. Note - Jab kuch dino tak lagatar barish aur baadh aa rhi ho to uske liye Rains and Floods ka use kar sakte hai.

questions.question: Mother-in-laws from different (a)/ daily soaps have been (b)/ nominated for this category.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'mothers-in-law' in place of 'mother-in-laws'. Compound noun ka plural karne ke liye noun ki tarah act karne wale word ka plural karte hain. Note :- Iss sentence me soaps ka matlb sabun nhi hai. 'daily soaps' matlb roj aane wale Tv serials.

questions.question: My neighbour's grandson (a)/ is only (b)/ five month old.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'months' instead of 'month'. kyunki 'five' ek numeral adjective hai iske baad plural noun ka use hoga.

questions.question: The efficiency of an (a)/ employee also depends on the (b)/ surrounding in which he or she works.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'surroundings' in place of 'surrounding'. yahan 'on' preposition ka object banane ke liye ek noun ki need hai. surrounding = adjective, surroundings = noun.

questions.question: There have been (a)/ three breaks-in (b)/ in our society (c)/ this month.(d)
questions.solution: use 'break-ins' instead of 'breaks-in'. kyunki 'break-in' ka plural 'break-ins' hota hai. Yeh aapko yaad hi karna padega. Break-in - the crime of entering a building by damaging a door or window, usually in order to steal.

questions.question: I want to know (a)/ where the headquarter of (b)/ Delhi police is situated.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'headquarters' in place of 'headquarter'. 'headquaters' un nouns me se hai jinki singular and plural me spelling same hi rehti hai.

questions.question: We bought (a)/ two dozens (b)/ mangoes from (c)/ the market.(d)
questions.solution: use 'two dozen' instead of 'two dozens'. kyunki yahan 'two dozen' ko 'mangoes' noun ke liye adjective ki tarah use kiya jaa raha hai isliye iska plural nahi hoga.

questions.question: Some seats are (a)/ reserved for disabled (b)/ in each compartment.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'the disabled' or 'disabled people' in place of 'disabled'. Yahan 'for' preposition ka object banane ke liye noun ki zarurat hai. The disabled = all the disabled people, The rich = all the rich people.

questions.question: I do not (a)/ like to read (b)/ these kind (c)/ of novels.(d)
questions.solution: use 'this kind or these kinds' instead of 'these kind'. plural noun ke sath 'these' and singular noun ke sath 'this' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The balance in his saving (a)/ account is not enough for him to (b)/ avail himself of these facilities.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'savings' in place of 'saving'. 'Savings' and 'Earnings' jab noun ka kaam karti hai tab humesha plural me hi likhe jaate hain. Savings - the money you keep, esp. in a bank or other financial organization. Earnings - the amount of money that someone is paid for working.

questions.question: Shall (a)/ we go (b)/ for walking (c)/ in the park?(d)
questions.solution: use 'a walk' instead of 'walking'. kyunki 'go for a walk/ride/drive/run/swim' ek fixed phrase hota hai. Note:- Jahan noun 'possible' hota hai wahan jabardasti gerund nahi lagate hain.

questions.question: The President of India (a)/ constitutional power is limitless (b)/ but it is the P.M. who is, (c)/ indeed, powerful.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'India's' in place of 'India'. Yahan kehna hai ki India ke president ki constitution power limitless hai isliye 'president of India' ka constitutional power par possession banane ke liye apostrophe (') lagega. Note :- Agar is sentence ka structure esa hota toh better hota 'the constitutional power of the president of India is limitless'.

questions.question: The Principal requested (a)/ the teacher's (b)/ to monitor (c)/ and take care of the small children.(d)
questions.solution: use teachers instead of teacher's. kyunki 'teacher' ka plural teachers hota hai teacher's nahi. Yahan koi possession nahi banana hai ki apostrophe (') lagaya jaye.

questions.question: There was (a)/ no money in the bank (b)/ in Dhananjay's (c)/ and Mritunjay's joint account.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'Dhananjay' in place of 'Dhananjay's'. Jab 2 nouns ka ek common cheez par possession hota hai toh apostrophe (') sirf baad wale noun par lagate hain.

questions.question: The boy had run away (a)/ because he couldn't stand (b)/ his father beat him (c)/ for one more day.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'his father's beating' instead of 'his father beat'. sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki- "wo ladka bhaag gya tha kyunki wo bardashta nahi kar paaya apne pita ki maar ko". 'Could not stand' verb ka object 'beating' gerund banega aur usse pehle likhe 'father' noun ko possessive case me karke father's karna padega.

questions.question: The offsprings of this (a)/ species leave their parents (b)/ as soon as they mature.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'offspring' in place of 'offsprings'. Kyunki 'offspring' ese nouns me se ek hai jinka singular and plural form same rehta hai.

questions.question: Doctors say that (a)/ home isolation is (b)/ far more effective (c)/ than hospitalize in cases of mild infection.(d)
questions.solution: use 'hospitalization' instead of 'hospitalize'. kyunki yahan 'isolation' noun se comparison karna hai aur noun ka comparison noun se hi hoga isliye 'hospitalization' ka use hoga. 'hospitalize' ek verb hoti hai jabki 'hospitalization' ek noun hota hai.

questions.question: He did not know even (a)/ the name of the scientist (b)/ who discovered (c)/ the laws of the earth gravitational force.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'earth's' in place of 'earth'. Celestial bodies ke sath apostrophe (') laga sakte hain.

questions.question: Your advices were timely (a)/ and guided me (b)/ to take the right decisions.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'pieces of advice / Bits of advice' instead of 'advices'. kyunki 'advice' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai isko plural banane ke liye 'pieces of advice' ka use karenge.

questions.question: His maid servant (a)/ behaviour is undoubtedly (b)/ indecent but I don't (c)/ understand how he tolerates it.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'servant's behaviour' in place of 'servant behaviour'. Yahan 'servant ka behaviour' yeh meaning dena hai isliye 'servant ka behaviour' par possession banane ke liye apostrophe (') lagana padega.

questions.question: She speaks (a)/ very highly (b)/ of both her (c)/ daughter-in-laws.(d)
questions.solution: use 'daughters-in-law' instead of 'daughter-in-laws'. kyunki 'daughter-in-law' ka plural 'daughters-in-law' hota hai.

questions.question: It was India's (a)/ past glory (b)/ that attracted a number of invaders in the remote past. (c)/no error (d)
questions.solution: No error. Note:- Country and city ke name ke sath apostrophe laga sakte hain. Eg. India's population = population of India, Delhi's pollution = pollution of Delhi.

questions.question: His loyalty (a)/ and honesty (b)/ are above (c)/ suspect.(d)
questions.solution: use 'suspicion' instead of 'suspect'. above suspicion = sandeh ke pare. Suspect - a person who is believed to be guilty of something. Suspicion - a belief or idea that something may or may not be true.

questions.question: Many of us don't (a)/ know the exact reason (b)/ behind the earthquake.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'cause' in place of 'reason'. Apne aap hone wale events ki wajah ke liye 'cause' word ka use karte hai.

questions.question: His mean (a)/ are very limited (b)/ yet he does not curtail (c)/ his expenditure and spends lavishly.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'means' in place of 'mean'. 'Income/resources' wale meaning me means word ka hi use hota hai iske sath verb plural aati hai.

questions.question: The information (a)/ you are (b)/ asking for (c)/ is quite irrelevance. (d)
questions.solution: use 'irrelevant' instead of 'irrelevance'. kyunki 'irrelevance' ek noun hai jabki 'irrelevant' ek adjective aur yahan adjective ki zarurat hai na ki noun ki.

questions.question: Annu saw (a)/ her shade (b)/ in the river.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'shadow' in place of 'shade'. Shadow = Parchhai, Shade = Dhoop se chhaya.

questions.question: The man played (a)/ the flute and led (b)/ all the mouse (c)/ out of the town.(d)
questions.solution: use 'mice' instead of 'mouse'. kyunki 'mouse' ka plural 'mice' hota hai.

questions.question: The French (a)/ have strange (b)/ habits.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'customs' in place of 'habits'. Ek single person ki aadat ke liye 'habit' word ka use hota hai aur society me koi aadat jisko sab follow karte hain uske liye 'custom (rivaaz)' word ka use hota hai.

questions.question: He loses (a)/ his tempers on (b)/ the slightest (c)/ provocation.(d)
questions.solution: use 'temper' instead of 'tempers'. kyunki 'temper' ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai.

questions.question: The Commonwealth Games had (a)/ a grand opening (b)/ ceremony with spectacular (c)/ cultural performings.(d)
questions.solution: use 'performances' instead of 'performings'. kyunki 'perform' verb ki noun form 'performance' hoti hai, 'performing' ko gerund maan ke use nahi kar sakte kyunki gerund ki plural form nahi hoti.

questions.question: The long-distance train (a)/ which met with an accident (b)/ was carrying some army personal.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'personnel' in place of 'personal'. Personal = Niji, Personnel = Staff.

questions.question: The publics are (a)/not satisfied (b)/ with the (c)/ new act.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the public is' instead of 'the publics are'. kyunki 'public' noun ko generally singular form me hi use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Your son's-in-law's (a)/ friend is seriously ill (b)/ and he wants you (c)/ to see him as soon as possible.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'sons-in-law's friend or son in law's friend' in place of 'son's-in-law's friend'. sons in law's friend = damadon ka friend, son in law's friend = damaad ka friend.

questions.question: They had to wait (a)/ for the luggages (b)/ to be put into the cab (c)/ before they themselves got into it.(d)
questions.solution: use 'luggage' instead of 'luggages'. kyunki luggage ek uncountable noun hai iska plural form nahi hota hai.

questions.question: The modern man is busy (a)/ acquiring more and more wealth (b)/ and designing ways to invest it (c)/ in more sense pleasures.(d)
questions.solution: use 'sensuous' instead of 'sense'. kyunki 'pleasure' ek noun hai iske pehle adjective ka use hoga, sense ek noun hai aur sensuous ek adjective hai. Note:- Generally 'pleasure' noun uncountable hota hai but agar pleasure ka use iss meaning me ho - 'a thing or activity that makes you happy' ko uska plural kiya ja sakta hai. Isliye yhan 'pleasures' noun me koi galti nhi hai.

questions.question: The survey gives (a)/ us much knowledge of the (b)/ public's opinion (c)/ on the matter of terrorism.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'public' in place of 'public's'. kyunki 'public opinion' ek compound noun ya fix expression hai.

questions.question: Among the reasons cited by the employee (a)/ for quitting the job were the pressure of work, the outstation duties (b)/ and desiring to pursue her hobbies.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'desire' instead of 'desiring'. kyunki yahan 'pressure of work', 'the outstation duties' aur 'desire to pursue her hobbies' in teen nouns ko join karna tha isliye yahan sentence me ek similarity banaye rakhne ke liye 'desire' noun ka use hoga na ki 'desiring' gerund ka, grammar me is concept ko parallelism kehte hain.

questions.question: 'Language consists of several stratums', (a)/ said a linguist (b)/ in his lecture on Language (c)/ and Linguistics.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'strata' in place of 'stratums'. stratum ka plural 'strata' hota hai.

questions.question: The chart papers (a)/ were distributed (b)/ among all (c)/ the childrens.(d)
questions.solution: use 'children' instead of 'childrens'. kyunki 'children' khud hi plural noun hai iska plural nahi hota hai.

questions.question: Your tone of speaking (a)/ as well as your friends (b)/ is extremely sarcastic (c)/ yet we never take it seriously.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'friend's' in place of 'friends'. kyunki sentence ke meaning ke according 'friend' ka tone par possession banana hai.

questions.question: My visiting to (a)/ my family are (b)/ few and far between.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'my visits to' instead of 'my visiting to'. kyunki 'visit' ek noun ban sakta hai aur 'are' verb se pta chal rha hai ki yahan plural noun ka use kiya jayega. Gerund ka plural form nahi hota. Note- agar noun lag sakta ho toh jabardasti gerund nahi lagate.

questions.question: He did not approve (a)/ of his son raising (b)/ stupid questions and thereby (c)/ vexing the teacher.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'son's' in place of 'son'. yahan meaning dena hai ki usne 'approve' nahi kiya uske 'son' ka stupid questions raise karna. Yahan 'approve of' phrasal verb ka object 'raising' gerund banega. Isliye 'son' noun ko possessive case me karna padega.

questions.question: These (a)/ stray cattles (b)/ are roaming around (c)/ the town.(d)
questions.solution: use 'cattle' instead of 'cattles'. kyunki 'cattle' khud hi ek plural noun hai.

questions.question: You shall get (a)/ all the informations (b)/ if you read this book carefully.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'information' in place of 'informations'. kyunki 'information' uncountable noun hai iska plural nahi hoga.

questions.question: We have taken on (a)/ the responsibility of (b)/ arranging the required training (c)/ and supervise of the new staff. (d)
questions.solution: Use 'supervising the new staff' in place of 'supervise of the new staff'. Yahan arranging and supervising gerunds ko and se joda gya hai isliye parallelism ke according gerund use hoga.

questions.question: 'I have never seen (a)/ such a lovely spectacles (b)/ in my life', said (c)/ the passer-by.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'spectacle' in place of 'spectacles'. Spectacles = chasma, Spectacle = drashya. sentence ke meaning ke according yahan spectacle aayega.

questions.question: With the literacy rates in this (a)/ region as low as 10% (b)/ we need to encourage the (c)/ local people to build schools.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'rate' in place of 'rates'. Kisi ek region ki literacy rate obviously ek hi hogi toh 'rate' noun ko singular me likha jayega.

questions.question: Hectic schedules can (a)/ take a toll on anybody and (b)/ the solutions to this is (c)/ a quick holiday to some exotic location.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'solution' in place of 'solutions'. Yahan 'the solution' noun ke liye 'is' singular verb ka use hua hai aur sentence me aage 'a quick holiday' bas ek yahi solution likha hai toh clear hai ki solution noun ko bhi singular me likhna padega.

questions.question: Owing to his heavy engagement, (a)/ he could not write even the two-third (b)/ of the book of which (c)/ the publication was extended before January.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'two-thirds' in place of 'two-third'. Jab 'fractions' ko words ki form me likhte hai toh agar numerator 1 ke alava kuchh hota hai toh 's' aata hai. eg. 1/3 = one third, 1/5 = one fifth, 2/5 = two fifths, 2/3 = two thirds.

questions.question: Since you are unable (a)/ to repay the loan you have no alternate (b)/ but to seek (c)/ an extension.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'alternative' instead of 'alternate'. Alternative = other option, Alternate = ek chhod ke ek. Eg. - I go there on alternate days.

questions.question: Some required measures (a)/ have to be taken to increase (b)/ the proceed of the annual sale.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'proceeds' in place of 'proceed'. proceed (verb) = aage badhna, proceeds (noun) = money or other property received as the result of a sale or other transaction especially involving collateral.

questions.question: My uncle's secretary's wife (a)/ is (b)/ very charming.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use The wife of my uncle's secretary in place of My uncle's secretary's wife. Sentence mein do apostrophe 's' ka use sath mein nahi karte, isliye meaning same karne ke liye isse 'of' structure se banayenge.

questions.question: It will take at least (a)/ one and a half year (b)/ to complete this project.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'years' in place of 'year'. one and a half = 1 + 1/2. Iske sath noun plural aayegi.

questions.question: The Karkardooma court has issued (a)/ five summons against him (b)/ so far, but he (c)/ has attended to none of them.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'summonses' in place of 'summons'. summons (singular) summonses (plural).

questions.question: I do not (a)/ know (b)/ my date of birth.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'the date of my birth' in place of 'my date of birth'. informal ya spoken me my date of birth hi bolte hain but grammar ke according the date of my birth sahi usage hai.

questions.question: The extra benefits in addition to its (a)/ flexibility of operation (b)/ and superior finish makes (c)/ it the most desirable machine of its kind.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'make' in place of 'makes'. is verb ka subject extra 'benefits' hai jo ki plural hai.

questions.question: Cannot you see (a)/ that the cattle (b)/ is grazing in the field ? (c)/ So, you cannot play there.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'are' in place of 'is'. 'cattle' plural noun hai uske liye plural verb aayegi.

questions.question: The gentry of Mumbai does not (a)/ like Salman khan at (b)/ all, even though he has (c)/a number of good movies to his credit.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'do' in place of 'does'. 'gentry' plural noun hai uske liye verb plural aayegi. Gentry - people of high social class.

questions.question: Would you please (a)/ tell me how many (b)/ soaps do you (c)/ use in a month.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'bars of soap' in place of 'soaps'. 'Soap' uncountable noun hai iska direct 's' ya 'es' laga ke plural nahi kar sakte hai. ek se zyada soaps kehne ke liye 'cakes' ya 'bars of soap' likhna padega.

questions.question: The Indian independence movement sought to establish the conceptions of freedom and social welfare as the goals of an independent Indian state, resulting in Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.
questions.solution: Yhan meaning ke according 'concepts of liberty' ka use hoga which means ideas of freedom.

questions.question: National development is defined as an improvement in people's daily arrangements, the provision of fundamental necessities to citizens such as food, education, social services, medical help, and so on, as well as increase in per capita income.
questions.solution: yhan meaning ke according 'living conditions' ka use hoga.

questions.question: In today's digital age, information is widely available to everyone by many means of media such as television, newspapers, films, and social media.
questions.solution: koi cheez jab kisi medium se transfer hoti hai uske liye 'through' ya 'via' ka use hota hai. B option me 'through any strategies' meaning se galat hai. isliye C option 'via various forms' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Disability was viewed as God's retribution for wickedness in the past.
questions.solution: yhan meaning ke according B option 'punishment for wrong doing' sahi h.

questions.question: I've got a lot of homeworks this weekend.
questions.solution: Homework uncountable noun hai iska plural nhi banta isliye B option galat hai. C option me 'a lots of' dia hai jo ki galat hai. D option isliye galat hai kyuki usme much diya hai jo ki negative ke liye use hota hai. A option 'a lot of homework' sahi hai.

questions.question:
Substitute the underlined words with the option that is closest in meaning to it.

Give us some room for improvement.
options: room in a house for improvement
questions.solution: room of improvement ka meaning hai scope, possible, chance of improvement. Isliye meaning ke according A option 'an opportunity of improvement' ayega.

questions.question: After a prolonged discussion, Gayatri got a permission from her parents to study law.
questions.solution: Permission (uncountable) :- the action of officially allowing someone to do a particular thing. Permissions (plural noun) official written statement allowing someone to do something. Yhan sentence ke meaning ke according permission uncountable noun ki tarah use hua hai isliye without article use hoga.

questions.question: Rumour mongering is one of the bad habit.
questions.solution: One + of + noun (plural) structure use hota hai kyuki 'of' preposition yhan selection ko dikha rhi hai. Isliye D option use hoga.

questions.question: Major hubs of the information technology industry is the Silicon Valley of Central California.
questions.solution: Sentence me subject ke liye singular verb use ki gyi hai or meaning ke according bhi subject singular hona chahiye isliye B option 'A major hub of' ka use hoga.

questions.question: My assistant will see you in the meets next week.
questions.solution: Yhan preposition ke baad noun chahiye isliye 'meeting' lagega. Next week diya hai isliye particular meaning hai isliye 'the meeting' ayega aur meeting ke sath 'at' preposition ayegi isliye D option 'at the meeting' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Megha's habit of procrastination puts her colleagues on lot of trouble.
questions.solution: 'a lot of / lots of' sahi phrases hote hain naki 'lot of' isliye B,C,D options galat hain. 'Put someone to trouble' means kisi ko pareshani me daalna.

questions.question: These days I like to eat nuts and seeds along with fruits as I'm conscious of my healthfulness.
questions.solution: yhan ek noun ki requirement hai. healthy and healthful dono adjective hote hain. healthfulness word generally nhi hota aur use karte hai bhi to ye khane ki cheezo ke liye lagaya jata naki person ke liye. Isliye yhan b option 'health' sahi hai.

questions.question: Bats huddle together to get warm of each other's body.
questions.solution: yhan 'to get' infinitive ka object bnane ke liye noun ki jarurat hai. 'warm' adjective hota hai isliye option B and C galat hain. A option isliye nhi hoga kyuki usme gerund hai jo noun + verb ka kaam karta hai yhan koi action show nhi karna hai isliye D option 'warmth from' sahi hai.

questions.question: India has identified a nose-based vaccine against Covid-19 that could be a 'game-changer'.
questions.solution: Nose based vaccine- Nose par aadharit vaccine. Nasal vaccine- nose ke through li jane wali vaccine. Obviously yahan sentence ke meaning ke according B option 'a nasal vaccine' hi aayega.

questions.question: These days, wherever district courts are functioning, hearings is limit to urgent matters.
questions.solution: 'hearings' ka yhan matlb hai court proceedings. Subject plural hai isliye verb bhi plural ayegi. isliye B and C options galat hai. Yhan present ki baat ho rhi hai isliye D option galat hai or A option 'hearings are limited' sahi hai.

questions.question: A large swarm of dogs was blocking the way.
questions.solution: Dogs ke group ke liye 'Pack' word ka use hota hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: In the jungle, I saw a group of lions.
questions.solution: Lions ke group ke liye 'Pride' word ka use hota hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: Tons of sheep was grazing in the field.
questions.solution: sheep ke group ke liye 'flock' word ka use hota hai isliye A option sahi hai.

questions.question: There is a great degrade in values in the modern age.
questions.solution: yhan meaning dena hai ki 'modern age me moral values me bhut kami aa gyi hai' isliye A option 'degradation of values' sahi hai.

questions.question: They started playing badminton at a young age of nine years old.
options: the young age of nine years old
a young age of nine years
questions.solution: A option 'at the young age of nine' sahi hai kyuki age word ka use karne ke baad dobara years lga ke structure bnana superfluous hai matlb unnecessary hai.

questions.question: The child started crying (a)/ because he couldn't stand (b)/ his mother scold him (c)/ in front of everyone (d).
questions.solution: replace 'his mother scold him' with 'his mother's scolding him'. Sentence mein 'stand' verb ka object 'scold' banega, kyunki 'scold' ek verb hai isliye isse object banane ke liye gerund 'scolding' mein badalna padega, aur sentence ka matlab hai 'uski mother kaa daantna', isliye yahan 'mother' par possession bhi ayega, isliye 'his mother's scolding him' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Several commander-in-chiefs (a)/ were invited to attend (b)/ the international defence summit (c)/ in Geneva (d).
questions.solution: replace 'commander-in-chiefs' with 'commanders-in-chief'. Sentence mein 'commander-in-chief' compound noun hai jiska plural karne ke liye 's' ka use noun ke sath hoga kyunki 'in-chief' adjectival phrase hai, 'commander' noun hai, isliye 'commanders-in-chief' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The newly adopted puppy (a)/ has gained weight (b)/ in just three week (c)/ after getting proper food and care (d).
questions.solution: replace 'week' with 'weeks'. Sentence mein 'three' se pata chal raha ki noun plural ayega, isliye yahan 'three weeks' sabse sahi answer hoga. Eg.- 'two boys, ten girls' etc.

questions.question: The mental health of students (a)/ is affected by the (b)/ surrounding in which they study and interact (c)/ with their teachers and peers (d).
questions.solution: replace 'surrounding' with 'surroundings'. 'surrounding' adjective hota hai, 'surroundings' noun hota hai, kyunki sentence mein 'by' preposition ko object ki jarurat hai, object noun yaa pronoun hote hai, isliye yahan 'surroundings' noun sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Due to an increase in (a)/ the number of breaks-in (b)/ the residents decided to install CCTV cameras (c)/ in the entire neighborhood (d).
questions.solution: replace 'breaks-in' with 'break-ins'. Sentence mein 'in' ke sath 's' ayega kyunki iske liye sahi term 'break-ins' hota hai aur yeh yaad hi rakhne waali baat hai, isliye 'break-ins' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Reporters gathered outside (a)/ the headquarter of (b)/ the Intelligence Bureau (c)/ to cover the press conference (d).
questions.solution: replace 'headquarter' with 'headquarters'. Kuch words aise hote hai jiski singular yaa plural form same hoti hai jaise 'headquarters, wages, whereabouts, offspring etc.', isliye yahan 'headquarters' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: They supplied (a)/ four dozen (b)/ pencils and (c)/ five dozens notebooks to the school (d).
questions.solution: replace 'five dozens' with 'five dozen'. Sentence mein 'five dozens' ki jagah 'five dozen' ayega kyunki 'notebooks' noun ke liye 'five dozen' quantitative adjective hai aur adjective ka plural nahi hota, isliye 'five dozen' sahi answer hoga. jaise 'pencils' noun se pehle 'four dozen' sahi hai.

questions.question: The government has announced (a)/ special schemes for disabled (b)/ to improve their standard of living (c)/ in rural areas (d).
questions.solution: put 'the' before 'disabled'. Sentence mein 'for' preposition ke baad 'object' ki jarurat hai, lekin 'disabled' adjective hota hai, agar 'the + qualitative adjective' likhte hai toh wo common plural noun ban jaata hai, jaise 'the poor, the weak, the rich etc.' waise hee 'the disabled' ka matlab 'disable log', isliye yahan 'the disabled' noun sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many readers prefer (a)/ these kind (b)/ of mystery stories which involve unexpected twists (c)/ and deep psychological elements (d).
questions.solution: replace 'these kind' with 'these kinds'. Sentence mein 'these' demonstrative adjective hai jiske baad noun plural aata hai, isliye yahan 'kinds' ayega jiske liye 'involve' plural verb likhi hai, isliye 'these kinds' plural noun sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He has kept the money deposited in his saving (a)/ account aside to (b)/ cover future expenses such as medical bills (c)/ and his children's education (d).
questions.solution: replace 'saving' with 'savings'. Generally 'saving' ke liye sahi term 'savings account' hoti hai, 'earnings, savings etc' yeh jo words hote hai humesha plural mein likhe jaate hai, isliye 'savings account' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After finishing all the household chores, (a)/ she suggested that they should (b)/ go for walking (c)/ on the beach (d).
questions.solution: replace 'for walking' with 'for a walk'. Sentence mein jadardasti 'walking' gerund ka use kiya hai kyunki jis kaam ke liye humhare pass noun 'a walk' hai, wahan gerund ki jarurat nahi hai, isliye yahan 'for a walk' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The Prime Minister of India (a)/ economic vision has been appreciated globally (b)/ as it focuses on sustainable development (c)/ and inclusive growth (d).
questions.solution: replace 'of india' with 'of india's'. Sentence mein 'the PM of india' aur 'economic vision' dono noun hai, lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'prime minister ka economic vision', matlab 'the PM of india' pe possession banana hai, isliye yahan 'india' pe apostrophe 's' ka use hoga, isliye 'the PM of India's' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The manager instructed (a)/ all the worker's (b)/ to attend the emergency meeting (c)/ without any delay (d).
questions.solution: replace 'the worker's' with 'the workers'. Sentence mein 'workers' par koi possession nahi banana hai, generally manager ne instruct kiya workers ko meeting attend karne ke liye, simply 'workers' ka plural form sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: During the shifting, (a)/ many old furnitures were (b)/ damaged badly because of poor packaging (c)/ and careless handling by the workers (d).
questions.solution: replace 'many old furnitures were' with 'a lot of/much old furniture was'. Kuch words jaise 'furniture, information, baggage, scenery etc.' yeh uncountable noun hote hai jinka plural nahi hota aur inke sath 'singular verb' aati hai aur 'uncountable' ke sath 'many' ka use nahi hota hai, isliye noun ki intensity badhaane ke liye yahan 'a lot of/much' adjective ka use karenge, noun aur verb dono singular ayenge, isliye 'a lot of/much furniture was' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In many bird species, (a)/ the offsprings remain in the nest (b)/ for several weeks before they learn to fly (c)/ and become independent (d).
questions.solution: replace 'offsprings' with 'offspring'. 'offspring' aisa noun hai jab iska matlab bacche hota hai toh chahe 'ek baccha ho yaa 10 bacche ho', isse plural mein nahi likhte, isliye yahan 'offspring' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Most doctors agree that home quarantine (a)/ proves to be more convenient and effective (b)/ than hospitalize in case (c)/ of a minor viral infection (d).
questions.solution: replace 'hospitalize' with 'hospitalization'. sentence mein 'than' ke baad noun aayega kyunki 'home quarantine' noun ka comparison karna hai aur comparison humesha same degree words mein hota hai, 'hospitalize' verb hai aur 'hospitalization' noun, toh noun ka noun se comparison ke liye 'hospitalization' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The students were amazed to learn (a)/ about the rotation and revolution (b)/ that are responsible for the earth gravitational changes (c)/ affecting the climate throughout the year (d).
questions.solution: replace 'earth gravitational' with 'earth's gravitational'. Sentence mein 'earth' aur 'gravitational changes' dono noun hai, lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'earth ka gravitational changes', matlab 'earth' ka 'gravitational changes' par possession banana hai, isliye 'earth' pe apostrophe 's' ka use hoga, isliye 'earth's gravitational changes' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Aman Sir gave me many useful advices (a)/ that helped me improve my English (b)/ and score better in the examination (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'many useful advices' with 'many pieces of useful advice'. Kuch words jaise 'furniture, information, baggage, scenery, advice etc.' yeh uncountable noun hote hai, inka plural form nahi hoti aur 'uncountable' ke sath 'many' ka use nahi hota hai, lekin 'many' ka use karna he chahte ho toh isse 'many pieces of useful advice' likhna padega.

questions.question: Delhi's (a)/ traffic problems (b)/ are increasing rapidly (c)/ due to poor urban planning and rising population. no error (d)
questions.solution: No error.

questions.question: The police (a)/ acted quickly (b)/ as there was a strong (c)/ suspect on the new employee (d).
questions.solution: replace 'suspect' with 'suspicion'. Sentence mein 'suspect' ki jagah 'suspicion' aayega kyunki 'suspect' ka matlab 'sandigdh' aur 'suspicion' ka matlab 'sandeh' hota hai, dono hee words noun hote hai, lekin sentence ke meaning ke according 'shak, sandeh' wala meaning sahi hoga, isliye yahan 'suspicion' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The experts could not (a)/ determine the exact reason (b)/ of the floods that led to (c)/ many casualties in the district (d).
questions.solution: replace 'reason' with 'cause'. Sentence mein 'reason' ki jagah 'cause' aayega kyunki 'reason' ka use tab hota jab koi kaam jaanboojh ke kiya jaaye, jabki 'cause' ka use tab hota jab koi kaam apne aap ho jaaye, sentence mein 'floods' aana apne aap hone waala kaam hai, isliye yahan 'the exact cause' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Although his mean (a)/ are not sufficient (b)/ to maintain such a luxurious lifestyle, (c)/ he throws grand parties every month (d).
questions.solution: replace 'mean' with 'means'. Sentence mein 'mean' ki jagah 'means' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'income, resources' waala matlab chahiye jiske liye 'means' ka use hota hai, baaki 'mean' 'adjective, verb, noun' ban sakta hai jiska alag alag meaning hota hai.

questions.question: The comments you made (a)/ during the meeting (b)/ were completely irrelevance (c)/ to the topic under discussion (d).
questions.solution: replace 'irrelevance' with 'irrelevant'. Sentence mein 'irrelevance' ki jagah 'irrelevant' ayega kyunki 'completely' adverb hai jiske baad adjective ki jarurat hai 'irrelevance' noun hai aur 'irrelevant' adjective hai.

questions.question: Shikha got frightened (a)/ when she noticed (b)/ her shade moving (c)/ on the wall behind her (d).
questions.solution: replace 'shade' with 'shadow'. Sentence mein 'shade' ki jagah 'shadow' aayega kyunki 'shade' ka matlab 'chaaya' jo tree ke niche banti hai aur 'parchaayi' ke liye 'shadow' ka use karte hai, sentence mein 'parchaayi' ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye 'shadow' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The farmer got worried (a)/ when he saw several mouse (b)/ eating the grains (c)/ stored in his barn (d).
questions.solution: replace 'mouse' with 'mice'. Sentence mein 'several' se pata chal raha ki noun plural ayega, 'mouse' ka plural 'mice' hota hai, isliye 'several mice' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: People in different parts of India (a)/ have their own distinct (b)/ habits when it comes to marriages and festivals (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'habits' with 'customs'. Sentence mein 'habits' ki jagah 'customs' aayega kyunki jab koi society/samaaj kisi cheez ko follow karta hai toh usse 'customs(riwaaz)' bolte hai, 'habits(aadat)' kisi particular insaan ki hoti hai.

questions.question: The coach warned the players (a)/ not to lose their tempers (b)/ on the field even if the referee made (c)/ an unfair decision (d).
questions.solution: replace 'tempers' with 'temper'. 'temper(aapa)' ek uncountable noun hai jiske plural nahi ho sakta, isliye 'temper' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The rescue team (a)/ immediately reached the site (b)/ where several navy personal were trapped (c)/ inside the damaged submarine (d).
questions.solution: replace 'navy personal' with 'navy personnel'. Sentence mein 'personal' ki jagah 'personnel' ayega kyunki 'personal' ek adjective hota hai, jabki 'personnel' noun hota hai jo 'poore staff' ko refer karta hai, sentence mein 'navy staff' ki baat karni hai, isliye 'personnel' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The publics are demanding (a)/ that the government should withdraw (b)/ the recently introduced education policy (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'publics are' with 'public is'. 'public' ek collective noun hai jiska plural nahi ho sakta aur iske sath singular verb aati hai, isliye yahan 'public is' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Your son's-in-law's (a)/ car broke down on the highway (b)/ while he was travelling (c)/ to Delhi for an official meeting (d).
questions.solution: replace 'son's-in-law's car' with 'son-in-law's car'. Sentence mein 'son-in-law' pe possession banana hai jiske liye apostrophe 's' ka use 'law' pe hoga aur 'son' pe 's' ka use nahi hoga kyunki noun pe 's' lagane se plural ho jata hai, isliye 'son-in-law's' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The committee conducted a nationwide poll (a)/ to understand the (b)/ public's opinion (c)/ on the recently proposed education reforms (d).
questions.solution: replace 'public's opinion' with 'public opinion'. Sentence mein 'public' pe 's' ka use nhi hoga kyunki 'public opinion' ek compound noun mana jata hai jiske sath apostrophe 's' ki jarurat nahi hoti, isliye 'public opinion' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Among the main factors (a)/ responsible for his resignation (b)/ were the long working hours, constant travel (c)/ and desiring to start his own business (d).
questions.solution: replace 'desiring' with 'desire'. Sentence mein parallelism follow hoga kyunki 'long working hours', 'constant travel' yeh noun hai aur 'and' conjunction se same type ke words ko connect karte hai, isliye 'desiring' gerund ki jagah par 'desire' noun aayega. Kyunki jo kaam direct noun se ho sakta hai wahan gerund ki jarurat nahi.

questions.question: The professor explained that (a)/ human society, like language, (b)/ is divided into multiple stratums (c)/ based on culture and education (d).
questions.solution: replace 'stratums' with 'strata'. Sentence mein 'multiple' se pata chal raha ki noun plural aayega aur 'stratum' ka plural 'strata' hota hai, isliye 'strata' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Gifts and sweets were distributed (a)/ among the childrens (b)/ on the occasion of the annual function of the school (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'childrens' with 'children'. 'child' ka plural 'children' hota hai jiske sath 's' ka use nahi hota, isliye 'children' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The manager appreciated (a)/ your dedication towards work (b)/ but said that your friends attitude (c)/ towards deadlines needs improvement (d).
questions.solution: replace 'friends' with 'friend's/ friends'. Sentence mein 'friends', 'attitude' do noun hai jo sath mein galat hai lekin sentence mein meaning dena hai 'friend ka attitude' matlab 'friend' pe possession banana hai isliye apostrophe 's' ka use hoga. agar ek hee friend hai toh 'friend's attitude' aayega, agar dost jyada hai toh 'friends' attitude' ayega.

questions.question: Her visitings to the office (a)/ have become irregular these days (b)/ as she is working on several field projects (c)/ in different parts of the country (d).
questions.solution: replace 'visitings' with 'visits'. Sentence mein 'visitings' ki jagah 'visits' aayega kyunki jo kaam direct noun kar sakta hai uss kaam ke liye gerund ki jarurat nahi hai aur 'have' se pata chal raha ki noun plural aayega, isliye 'visits' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many cattles have been reported missing (a)/ from the nearby villages (b)/ due to the heavy rains (c)/ and broken fences (d).
questions.solution: replace 'cattles' with 'cattle'. Sentence mein 'cattles' ki jagah 'cattle' aayega kyunki 'cattle' pehle se hee plural noun hai aur isme 's' lagake plural karne ke jarurat nahi hai.

questions.question: The teacher provided (a)/ all the necessary informations (b)/ about the upcoming examination (c)/ to the students during the meeting (d).
questions.solution: replace 'informations' with 'information'. 'information' ek uncountable noun hai jiska plural nahi hota, aur 'all' countable aur uncountable dono ke sath aata hai, isliye 'all the necessary information' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The committee is responsible for (a)/ organizing the annual event (b)/ and prepare the list of guest speakers (c)/ before the deadline (d).
questions.solution: replace 'prepare' with 'preparing'. Sentence mein parallelism follow hoga kyunki committee responsible hai 'organize' aur 'prepare' karne ki, agar 'organizing' gerund mein likha hai toh 'preparing' bhi gerund mein hee aayega, isliye yahan 'preparing' gerund sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Everyone gathered near the riverbank (a)/ to watch such a magnificent spectacles (b)/ created by the colorful lights (c)/ and the flowing water (d).
questions.solution: replace 'spectacles' with 'spectacle'. Pair noun humesha plural chalte hai jab 'spectacles, optical glasses' inka matlab 'chasmah' hota hai, lekin sentence mein 'spectacle' ka matlab 'drishya, nazara' hai aur 'a' article se bhi pata chal raha ki singular ki baat ho rahi hai aur yahan 'chasmeh' wala meaning nahi chahiye, isliye yahan 'spectacle' ke sath 's' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: As the bridge was getting repaired (a)/ the villagers had no alternate (b)/ but to take the longer route (c)/ through the dense forest to reach the market (d).
questions.solution: replace 'alternate' with 'alternative'. Sentence mein 'alternate' ki jagah 'alternative' aayega kyunki 'alternate' ek adjective hai jiska matlab 'har ek ko chhodkar dusra', jabki 'alternative' noun hota hai jiska matlab 'do ya do se jyada possibilities mein decide karna', sentence mein 'decide' karne wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'alternative' noun sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Because of multiple server issues, (a)/ he could solve only (b)/ three-fourth of the questions in the exam (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'three-fourth' with 'three-fourths'. Yeh jo fractions hoti hai isme agar numerator mein 'one' ho toh denominator mein 's' nahi aayega jaise 'one-third, one fourth', agar numerator mein 'one' ke alava baaki number hai toh denominator mein 's' aayega jaise 'two-thirds, three-fourths'.

questions.question: The teacher said (a)/ it would take around (b)/ one and a half month (c)/ to finish the syllabus (d).
questions.solution: replace 'half month' with 'half months'. Sentence mein 'month' ki jagah 'months' aayega kyunki koi bhi cheez 'one' se jyada ho toh usse plural consider karte hai chahe wo 'half' he jyada ho, isliye yahan 'one and a half months' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The committee decided (a)/ to donate the proceed of the charity event (b)/ to the families affected by the recent floods (c)/ in the northern region (d).
questions.solution: replace 'proceed' with 'proceeds'. Sentence mein 'proceed' ki jagah 'proceeds' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'proceed' ka matlab 'jo amount collect hua hai' aur iss case mein yeh noun humesha plural aata hai jaise 'earnings, savings' waise he yahan 'proceeds' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: My cousin's manager's car (a)/ broke down (b)/ on the highway (c)/ while he was returning from his office (d).
questions.solution: replace 'my cousin's manager's car' with 'the car of my cousin's manager'. Sentence mein do apostrophe 's' ka use sath mein nahi karte, isliye meaning same karne ke liye isse 'of' structure se banayenge, isliye 'the car of my cousin's manager' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The district court (a)/ has already issued three summons (b)/ to the director of the company, (c)/ but he did not appear before the court (d).
questions.solution: replace 'summons' with 'summonses'. Sentence mein 'summons' ki jagah 'summonses' aayega kyunki 'three' se pata chal raha ki noun plural aayega aur 'summons' ka plural 'summonses' hota hai.

questions.question: She could not (a)/ remember (b)/ my time of arrival (c)/ when the police asked her about it (d).
questions.solution: replace 'my time of arrival' with 'the time of my arrival'. Sentence 'my time of arrival' galat phrase hai, iski jagah sahi phrase 'the time of my arrival' aayega, kyunki yahan hume arrival par possession banana hai na ki time par. Eg.- 'my date of birth' ki jagah sahi phrase 'the date of my birth'.

questions.question: The various facilities of the hotel (a)/ along with its excellent service (b)/ and peaceful environment makes (c)/ it one of the best resorts in the region (d).
questions.solution: replace 'makes' with 'make'. Sentence mein 'various facilities' subject ki verb 'makes' hai kyunki subject plural hai jiske according plural verb aayegi, verb mein 's/es' lagane se singular ho jaati hai, isliye yahan 'make' plural sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She (a)/ bought two breads (b)/ from the (c)/ bakery this morning. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'two breads' with 'two loaves of bread'. 'bread' ek uncountable noun hai isliye 'two breads' galat hoga, 'poori bread' ke liye 'loaf' ka use karte hai, aur iska plural 'loaves' hota hai, isliye yahan 'two loaves of bread' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The handwriting of the teacher (a)/ as well as the students (b)/ was appreciated by the principal (c)/ during the meeting. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the students' with 'the student's/students'. Sentence mein 'of' se 'teacher' ka handwriting pe possession ban gaya lekin 'students' ka possession nahi bana, aur 'as well as' se pata chal raha ki 'teacher aur students' dono ka possession banana hai, isliye 'students' ka possession banane ke liye apostrophe 's' ka use karenge, agar single student ki baat karenge toh 'student's' aur plural ki baat karenge toh 'students'.

questions.question: The principal appreciated (a)/ Ravi's and Kiran's (b)/ duet that they sang in (c)/ the annual function. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'ravi's' with 'ravi'. Sentence mein 'duet' se pata chal raha ki 'ravi aur kiran' dono ka gaana hai, toh do noun pe possession banane ke liye sirf last waale noun pe apostrophe 's' ka use karte hai, isliye 'ravi and kiran's' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The government's main goal under the new welfare policy is to enhance people's daily lifestyles by providing better housing, education, and employment opportunities.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'better housing, education and employment opportunities' se pata chal raha ki 'jeevan jeene ke liye jo buniyadi cheeze hai' unki baat ho rahi jiske liye 'living standards' term ka use karte hai, isliye option B sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the flood blocked all roads and vehicles stopped moving, villagers had no option but to reach the nearby shelter by walk through the muddy fields.
questions.solution: Sentence mein pata chal raha ki 'pedal jana pada' jiske liye 'on foot' sabse sahi term hai, isliye option C sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In ancient civilizations, natural disasters like floods and earthquakes were often considered as God's revenge for people's sins, leading to mass prayers and sacrifices to please the deities.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'revenge for people's sins' ke liye sahi phrase 'punishment for wrongdoings' hoga, baaki saare option iske opposite hai, isliye option B sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After several requests, the students finally received a permission from the principal to organize the annual cultural festival.
questions.solution: 'permission' ek uncountable noun hai jiske sath 'a,an' article ka use nahi hota, 'the' use ho sakta hai jab koi specific permission ki baat ho. Option A galat hoga kyunki 'all' ke baad plural noun aayega. option D bhi galat hai. option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'proper' ka jabardasti use galat hai, isliye option C 'received permission' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Although the project report was well prepared and neatly presented, there is still some space for correction before we submit it to the board.
questions.solution: Jab apan kehte 'abhi thode sudhaar ki jarurat hai', iske liye 'there is some room for improvement' phrase ka use kiya jaata hai, isliye option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The students could not go out to play because they had many homeworks to complete before Monday morning.
questions.solution: 'homework' ek uncountable noun jiske plural nahi ho sakta, isliye option D galat hoga. option A aur C bhi galat honge kyunki 'many, several' ka use uncountable ke sath nahi hota. Isliye option B 'a lot of homework' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: After the meeting was over, the manager said that no other informations was conveyed to him regarding the new policy changes.
questions.solution: 'information' uncountable noun jiska plural nahi ho sakta, isliye option B galat hoga, option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'none' contradictory word hai. option A bhi galat hoga 'other's' dono pe possession se galat meaning aayega, isliye option C 'no other information' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: A frightened man called the police when a swarm of dogs started chasing him on the main road.
questions.solution: 'kutton ke jhund' ke liye 'pack of' collective noun ka use hota hai, isliye option A 'pack of dogs' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The researchers announced that India has successfully developed a nose-based vaccine to provide stronger immunity against the new Covid variant.
questions.solution: Jo medicine 'nose' ke through le jaati hai uske liye 'nasal' term ka use kiya jata hai, isliye option B 'a nasal vaccine' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: These days, I avoid junk food completely and prefer homemade meals and green smoothies since I've become more conscious of my healthfulness.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'my' adjective ke baad 'noun' ki jarurat hai. option A aur C galat honge kyunki 'healthful' aur 'healthy' dono adjective hai. option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'healthfulness' word awkward ya uncommon hota hai, isliye option B 'health' noun sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While on a safari in Africa, we were thrilled to see a group of lions resting under a large acacia tree.
questions.solution: 'lions' ke group ke liye 'pride' collective noun ka use hota hai, isliye option A 'a pride of lions' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Ramesh started learning computer programming at a very early age of ten years old and soon became skilled in coding.
options: a very early age of ten
the very early age of ten years
a very early age of ten years
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'age' noun ka use ho chuka hai isliye dubara 'years', 'old' likhne ki jarurat nahi kyunki yeh superfluous ho jayega, isliye diye gaye options mein se option A 'a very early age of ten' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The tailor handed over my new trouser yesterday, but I found the fitting slightly loose at the waist.
questions.solution: 'trouser' ek pair noun hai, isliye isse plural mein likhte hai, isliye 'pair of trousers' option D sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She purchased three dozens eggs from the market.
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'dozens' adjective hai jo 'eggs' ko qualify kar raha hai, kyunki adjective ka plural nahi ho sakta, isliye 'dozens' ka plural nahi hoga, isliye 'three dozen eggs' option C sabse sahi answer hoga. Note:- 'of' wala structure 'dozens of eggs' tab use karenge jab hume fixed quantity naa pata ho.
